crossRefs.note: You will be blessed above all peoples. There won’t be male or female barren among you, or among your livestock.
You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of…
Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of…
I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine…
Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons…
Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.
So Job died, being old and full of days.
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow…
“No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child…

translations.web: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.
translations.bsb: No woman in your land will miscarry or be barren; I will fulfill the number of your days.
translations.kjv: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
translations.asv: There shall none cast her young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.
